title: ai settings / Custom agents settings
content:
## Custom agents settings | Setting and Description | Default | |------------------------|---------------| | `setting(chat.agentFilesLocations)`
Additional custom agent locations discovered by the editor and forwarded to Agent Host harnesses. Supported, but not recommended for Copilot workflows because other clients do not inherit this setting. Prefer [native harness locations](/docs/agent-customization/migrate-customizations.md#move-customizations-from-configured-locations). | `{ ".github/agents": true, ".claude/agents": true, "~/.copilot/agents": true }` | | `setting(github.copilot.chat.cli.customAgents.enabled)`
Enable using custom agents in Copilot harness sessions. | `false` | | `setting(github.copilot.chat.organizationCustomAgents.enabled)`
Enable discovery of custom agents defined at the GitHub organization level. | `true` |
